column1: # The filesystem property test's generator rules, shared by the 4 bindings'
# runners, so one seed draws one case in each. Tab-separated. Changing a row's
# order, or adding one, changes what every seed draws.
# A case is drawn from splitmix64 seeded with the case number, each draw the
# next output modulo the count, in this order: the file at w/t.shcl there or
# not (2), o/t.shcl there or not (2), the load spelling, the save spelling,
# the number of events (1, plus a draw of 2), each event, create (1 in 4), force
# (1 in 4). Every row counts in a draw on every platform, so a case is the
# same everywhere, and a case that drew a row not for this platform is
# The tree: the case's root holds w/ (the working folder), o/ (another one)
# and w/sub/ with sub/t.shcl. Off windows w/ also has lw -> . , lt.shcl ->
# t.shcl, dl.shcl -> gone.shcl, and cy.shcl and cy2.shcl pointing at each
# other. nodir and nd are not there until an event makes them.

column2: {W} is w/'s absolute path, {S} its 8.3 short form.
write-load and write-save write other bytes through that spelling, which
rewrites a file or makes one where there was none. mkdir makes nodir and
nd. link-made makes nd a link to sub. relink points lw at sub and lt.shcl
at sub/t.shcl. chdir swaps the save's working folder between w and o.
unread takes the read bits off what the load spelling names.
